desc: Ideation: identify each element's required selections as its base-4 digit length and candidate answer as max(max selections, ceil(total selections / 2)).
Implement Solution.minOperations using the per-query level-count formula and verify the two provided examples.
Validate the scheduling formula via Hall/b-matching argument and sample tests.
Check edge cases and performance: l = 1, r = 10^9, ranges crossing powers of 4, O(Q log_4 r) time, O(1) memory, Python integer arithmetic.
